origin: Follow-up after sinc-path-patch-v1 rejected input-induced envelope drift as major cause. Preplanned controls showed allocation sensitivity; this newly frozen stage resolves native-norm vs donor-norm and ReLU-switch confounds. Same seen cohort, not newtest. Do not rewrite original hypothesis as confirmed.
hypothesis: In the fixed focal16 middle-frequency failure conditions, native frequency-selective feature attenuation has an adverse allocation conditional on current features and decoder. A uniform allocation matched exactly to native feature-step norm restores positive direction/gain, including with the zero-cell ReLU gates frozen. Total feature-step norm and ReLU switching cannot alone account for this difference.

interventions.recipient: Only eta1 of each fixed48families. No donor swaps/newpermutations. U from original zero-cell query, native W from original frequency. Original encoder/coef/omega/carrier/phase/skip/ensemble/MLP retained.
interventions.uniform: t=RMS(U*(W-1))/RMS(U), constant envelope1-t. Exact same aggregate4branch4096query256feature norm as native correction. Compute without truth.
interventions.outputs: point=sum weights D(U)/2+skip/2+.5; native=sum weights D(U*W)/2+skip/2+.5; uniform=sum weights D(U*(1-t))/2+skip/2+.5; fixed_native=point+sum weights J_D(U)[U*(W-1)]/2; fixed_uniform=point+sum weights J_D(U)[-t*U]/2. Same point baseline. Frozen gates are exact affine counterfactual, not approximation to full network.
interventions.checks: Original float32 endpoints against oldcohort; matchedfeature RMS1e-12; original prior full/native2e-6; sham not expected identity for uniform; both benefits and harm retained. Autograd JVP and fixedmask finite step on saved16queries preflight+firstformal for both increments.

evaluation.primary: All32mid, focalold16, nonflip16, sham16. Focal16 middleband paired native vs uniform with full/frozen separately. Report sign counts, negative gain rescued, mean/median MSE improvements and all cases. RGB center/full side effects retained. No CI for dependentgrid.
evaluation.support_gate: Both full and fixed modes require >8/16 focal native negative gains rescued to >=-1e-8, median native-minus-uniform MSE>1e-8; full RGB center median no worse than native beyond1e-8. If fixed restoration fails, cannot claim recovery independent of gate switching. This gate is a bounded descriptive claim check, not statistical significance. Stronger all16 statement only if actually observed.

freeze: Newcode/protocol/cohort hash before execution; verify original manifests/checkpoint/helper. All predictions/probes frozen before truth score. Retrospective cohort. No code change in launched root.

budget.resume: none; fixedabsolute launchdeadline plus cumulative phases, subprocess timeout; failures preserved; newversion/root for changes

limitations: Conditional allocation intervention, not identification of useful vs harmful individual channels
No evidence learnedfrequency equalsoutputfrequency or is estimatedincorrectly
Uniform changes space/channel allocation; prior permutation provides complementary channel-addressing evidence
Generalization and deployable selector not established; lowcontrol harm retained
